meta.name: paywall-pricing-optimizer
meta.description: Design effective paywalls, structure subscription tiers, and optimize pricing for mobile apps. Covers monetization model selection, paywall screen design, pricing psychology, A/B testing strategy, and RevenueCat/StoreKit/Google Billing integration. Use when the user wants to monetize an app, design a paywall, choose between subscription vs one-time purchase, set pricing tiers, improve conversion rates, plan pricing experiments, or integrate in-app purchases. Triggers on "design my paywall", "how should I price my app", "subscription tiers", "monetization strategy", "paywall copy", "free trial length", "RevenueCat setup", "improve paywall conversion".
